title: Warranty Claims & Technical Reports

expressions.expr: Is this unit still under warranty?
expressions.meaning: Esta unidade ainda está na garantia?
expressions.example: Here is the serial number. Is this unit still under warranty?

expressions.meaning: Se o problema continuar, posso te ligar de volta?

sentences: The customer reported an error code on the display.
This receiver is still under warranty.
We attached the error log and the photos to the report.
The warranty covers factory defects for one year.
Water damage is not covered by the warranty.
If the problem continues, we will replace the board.
If it still fails, they will ship a replacement unit.
The manufacturer approved the warranty claim today.

grammar.title: First Conditional: combinando planos de contingência (If… + will)
rules: Use If + Presente Simples na condição, e will + verbo base no resultado.
Exemplo clássico da Aula 1: "If it still fails, we will send you a replacement antenna."
Também pode usar can no resultado: "If the problem continues, can I call you back?"
Atenção: depois do IF, use o presente ("If it fails"), nunca "If it will fail".

rows: Se tiver qualquer problema, me ligue.
Se estiver na garantia, não há custo.
